title: The Beast of Millbrook
description: Millbrook's flocks are down by half since planting season. Shepherd Ansel Crake lost the last of his sheep two nights ago and has stopped taking his cart out after dark. Vorn is calling this a Veteran contract because whatever is doing it has already ducked three separate hunting parties from the village - it is smart enough that dead livestock is the good outcome.

objectives.description: Ask the Millbrook elder what Ansel Crake and the others have lost
Track the beast past where three hunting parties already turned back
Kill the dire wolf alpha before Millbrook loses anything else
Take a trophy from the beast

notes: Rank: Member -> Veteran (promotion). Monster hunt with tracking mechanics. Dire wolf spawns in den near Millbrook. Promotion to Veteran rank on completion. Threat: a named shepherd, Ansel Crake, has lost his whole flock, and the village's own hunting parties have failed three times. Giver motive: Vorn only calls something Veteran-tier once local hunters have already failed. Consequence: more of Millbrook's livestock and, eventually, people, are named as at risk if it isn't found - stated in prose, not wired.
